descFull: Kapso by Leeroo: an engine that runs experiments toward an objective, deploys the best solution on your stack and learns from every run into a bank of lessons with a credence score and a boundary. First on RelBench and ALE-Bench, top open-source on MLE-Bench, above every human contestant at IOAI 2026.
